children: FORD MOTOR COMPANY IS RECALLING 36,994 U.S. VEHICLES - NHTSA

FORD MOTOR COMPANY IS RECALLING SOME U.S. VEHICLES AS A FRONT PASSENGER SEAT THAT MOVES UNEXPECTEDLY CAN CONTACT SECOND-ROW PASSENGERS, OR FORCE THE FRONT PASSENGER INTO AN UNSAFE SEATING POSITION, INCREASING THE RISK OF INJURY.- NHTSA

title: NHTSA Says Ford Motor Company Is Recalling 36,994 U.S. Vehicles As Front Passenger Seat May Move Unexpectedly
